import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define ctypes-compatible structures
class GSLVector(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("size", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("stride", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ("block", ctypes.c_void_p),
        ("owner", ctypes.c_int)
    ]

class GSLMatrix(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("size1", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("size2", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("tda", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ("block", ctypes.c_void_p),
        ("owner", ctypes.c_int)
    ]

class GSLMultifitFunctionFDF(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("n", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("p", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("f", ctypes.c_void_p),
        ("df", ctypes.c_void_p),
        ("fdf", ctypes.c_void_p),
        ("params", ctypes.c_void_p)
    ]

# Define the function prototype
gsl.gsl_multifit_fdfsolver_dif_df.argtypes = [
    ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector),
    ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector),
    ctypes.POINTER(GSLMultifitFunctionFDF),
    ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector),
    ctypes.POINTER(GSLMatrix)
]
gsl.gsl_multifit_fdfsolver_dif_df.restype = ctypes.c_int

def gsl_multifit_fdfsolver_dif_df(x, wts, f, n, p):
    # Convert Python lists to GSL vectors
    x_array = np.array(x, dtype=np.float64)
    wts_array = np.array(wts, dtype=np.float64)
    f_array = np.array(f, dtype=np.float64)

    x_gsl = GSLVector(size=len(x), stride=1, data=x_array.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)), block=None, owner=0)
    wts_gsl = GSLVector(size=len(wts), stride=1, data=wts_array.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)), block=None, owner=0)
    f_gsl = GSLVector(size=len(f), stride=1, data=f_array.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)), block=None, owner=0)

    # Create an empty Jacobian matrix
    J_array = np.zeros((n, p), dtype=np.float64)
    J_gsl = GSLMatrix(size1=n, size2=p, tda=p, data=J_array.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)), block=None, owner=0)

    # Create a dummy fdf structure
    fdf = GSLMultifitFunctionFDF(n=n, p=p, f=None, df=None, fdf=None, params=None)

    # Call the C function
    status = gsl.gsl_multifit_fdfsolver_dif_df(ctypes.byref(x_gsl), ctypes.byref(wts_gsl), ctypes.byref(fdf), ctypes.byref(f_gsl), ctypes.byref(J_gsl))

    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"GSL function returned error code {status}")

    # Convert the Jacobian matrix to a Python list of lists
    return J_array.tolist()

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1
    x = [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]
    wts = [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]
    f = [0.1, 0.2, 0.3]
    n = 3
    p = 3
    J = gsl_multifit_fdfsolver_dif_df(x, wts, f, n, p)
    assert isinstance(J, list), "Output should be a list of lists"
    assert len(J) == n, "Number of rows in Jacobian matrix should match n"
    assert len(J[0]) == p, "Number of columns in Jacobian matrix should match p"

    # Test case 2 (edge case)
    x = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    wts = [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]
    f = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    n = 3
    p = 3
    J = gsl_multifit_fdfsolver_dif_df(x, wts, f, n, p)
    assert all(all(val == 0.0 for val in row) for row in J), "Jacobian matrix should be all zeros for zero input"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
